entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: Crocodile-headed god of Amonkhet embodying ambition, who secretly helped Nicol Bolas and became a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who created the pantheon, conquered Amonkhet and struck Bontu down; a planeswalker.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: Bontu's sister god, the only surviving god of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God who was turned into a God-Eternal and ordered against Bolas.

entities.name: God-Eternals
entities.description: Gods zombified by Bolas to serve as undying weapons.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Necromancer planeswalker who turned against Bolas and seized control of Bontu and Oketra.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who impaled Bolas with Hazoret's spear.

entities.name: Bontu's Monument
entities.description: Large monument where the Trial of Ambition took place.

entities.name: Trial of Ambition
entities.description: The fourth trial, overseen by Bontu.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle on Ravnica where the God-Eternals fought.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the War of the Spark.

events.summary: Bontu reveals she secretly helped Bolas conquer Amonkhet, betraying her plane and fellow gods.
events.quote: Bontu revealed that she had secretly helped Nicol Bolas conquer Amonkhet

events.summary: Bolas orders Bontu to kill Hazoret; she defeats her, then Bolas betrays and strikes Bontu down.
events.quote: Bolas betrayed Bontu without hesitation and struck her down

events.summary: Bolas zombifies Bontu into a God-Eternal.
events.quote: Bontu was zombified by Nicol Bolas and transformed into one of the God-Eternals

events.summary: Liliana seizes control of Bontu and Oketra and orders them to attack Bolas.
events.quote: she seized control of Bontu and Oketra

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas; Bontu bites him and harvests all his stolen sparks but is torn apart in an explosion.
events.quote: was torn apart in a final explosion

relations.note: struck her down after her betrayal of Hazoret
relations.quote: Bolas betrayed Bontu without hesitation and struck her down

relations.note: ordered by Bolas to kill her; defeated her in combat

relations.quote: Bontu willingly allied with the elder dragon
